notes.title: Quality of Life / Improvements Update
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Can choose to not spend temporary perks at Abyss Wormhole entrance.
- Warpgates and Wormholes now require pressing the "action" button to enter.
- Cleaner scene changes with black screen fade-in's, have been added.
- Sentinel tips added.
- Other small improvements added.

notes.title: Improvements / Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Added extra new game intro scene
- Fixed a collision issue
- "Dominance" Titan ground tail strike attack now shows an anticipation marker
- When Titans are in an invulnerable state, the state text is displayed near their health bar
- Added Hollow dungeon map icons related to the Titan
- Added telegraphing for damage application in the Hollow dungeon Titan fight
- Additional Beginner's Guide info has been added

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Implemented mouse hover in the Skills UI, locked skills show additional info
- Updated Beginner's Guide (more to come!)
- Removed Beginner's Guide from the main menu 
- Fixed a couple of collision issues
- New name proudly added to the credits thank you section

notes.title: General Update
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Added option to force 1080p resolution, suited for 1440p and other resolutions to ensure crisp visuals.
- Titans now drop energy essence orbs.
- Enemy pathfinding fix and fine tuning.

notes.title: Performance Optimisations + More!
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Enemy performance optimisations
- Extra new player tip clips added
- HUD / UI effects added for when gaining new energy slots and when navigating the Skills interface
- Slight lighting tweaks

notes.title: Display Fix Solution
notes.content: - Fixed quality display issue for certain resolutions, such as 1440p.

notes.title: New Player Tip Improvements
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
- Added new game tips
- Revised and improved previous game tips
- Extra small tips added to main menu intro screen

notes.title: Relic Vault and Improvements Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes:
- "Relic Vault" feature implemented, allows players to store Relics and Sigils (find in the Sentinel Link UI, future update will add option to drop relics/sigils directly from the vault)
- New players are greeted by Sentinel at the main menu
- Main menu VAGRIENT Games Discord server link button added
- Main menu Plabs_ content creator Twitch profile link button added
- Character dialogue portrait art added
- Phased Dash tip now has a video clip to assist and show new players how to chain the ability
- Can skip intro cutscene
- Intro cutscene story dialogue text added
- Added player feedback messages when interacting with universe and UI

notes.title: EXPANSION ICEBURN
notes.content:
[h1][b]DELVE DEEPER INTO THE ICE RUINS![/b][/h1][p][b][i]Since the defeat of Cerbacore and restoration of the corrupted Warpgate, a place deep beneath the Ice Ruins has been exposed waiting to be explored. Take on the challenge of this new-found location and be rewarded![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][h2][u]EXPANSION ICEBURN UPDATE NOTES[/u][/h2][p][/p][h3]Graphics[/h3][list][*][p]Complete rework of graphics and visual effects which includes improved lighting, vignette effect and colours. Normal maps and shaders added, all characters and environment have been visually improved. Environment edge variations added for a more natural look. Things such as relics, projectiles etc. illuminate in the dark.[/p][/*][*][p]Ambient lightning effects plus close lightning strikes that can occur which can strike enemies, player and environment.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
New Content[/h3][list][*][p]A new expansion themed dungeon location has been added, featuring a unique mechanic. It also contains a new enemy, item and more![/p][/*][*][p]Abyssal Totem "Boosters" can be found in The Abyss for an enhanced experience and promotes further player competition on the Steam Leaderboard![/p][/*][*][p]New skill added![/p][/*][*][p]New music added.[/p][/*][*][p]Sentinel companion assist dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]New Steam Achievement.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Quality of Life Features[/h3][list][*][p]Remappable controls![/p][/*][*][p]When viewing the controls menu section, the player can toggle between gamepad and keyboard controls.[/p][/*][*][p]The game auto-detects whether an XBox or Playstation controller is connected to display the correct glyphs in the controls menu section with further plans to better support other controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]New Skills UI added, allowing the player to view and manage all of their skills in one place.[/p][/*][*][p]New Solar System map added, allowing the player to better track their location.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated menu beginners guide for the player to refer to for in-depth info.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified controls system has been implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]In-game settings added along with a screen brightness setting.[/p][/*][/list][h3]
Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Inventory/Map/Objectives button changed to "Sentinel Link".[/p][/*][*][p]Skill and Sigil item effects have been adjusted, with new effects added.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved new player experience/introduction.[/p][/*][*][p]Player now selects their active skills using the new Skills UI.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed warpgate entry incorrect spawn location from planet ROC to LAV bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed charge attack buff projectiles no longer interfere with the Spirit in the Crystal Catacombs.[/p][/*][*][p]A couple of other minor bugs fixed.[/p][/*][/list]
